name: Member Address List
query:
SELECT
    member.name,
    member.first_name,
    member.last_name,
    address.address_line1,
    address.pincode,
    address.city
FROM `tabAddress` address

JOIN `tabDynamic Link` dl
ON dl.parent = address.name
AND dl.parenttype = 'Address'
AND dl.link_doctype = 'LANDA Member'

JOIN `tabLANDA Member` member
ON member.name = dl.link_name
